title: DOMAIN_CHANGE_REQUEST
description: An agent stops because the domain spec is wrong or incomplete for its work; kent sends it to hughes, who settles it with the user.

entry.description: The spec id, or the entity, event or operation name; "new" for an entry the spec lacks.

before.description: The entry as it is, or "none".

after.description: The entry as the work needs it.

reason.description: The test, interface or fact that forces it.
